rationale: The individual coverage cache was unavailable, so I used raw hit rates on the 16 baseline D* docs from eval_merge_base as the coverage proxy. rule_page12_form_path_period is the cheapest broad rule that reaches all baseline 10-K and 10-Q docs, while rule_page12_8k_event_line is the only rule that reaches the four baseline 8-K docs.
